atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLen = input(60, "Coil Lookback", 20, 120, 1)
rangeLen = input(60, "Range Lookback", 20, 120, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "VoV Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
relMult = input(1.8, "Release Range Multiplier", 1.0, 3.0, 0.1)
coilThresh = input(80, "Coil Threshold", 50, 95, 1)
predThresh = input(0.35, "Predictable Threshold", 0.1, 0.8, 0.05)
unpredThresh = input(0.20, "Unpredictable Threshold", 0.05, 0.4, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

a = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rng = high - low
rngLow = lowest(rng, rangeLen)
rngHigh = highest(rng, rangeLen)
rangeCoil = 100 * (1 - (rng - rngLow) / (rngHigh - rngLow + 0.000001))
atrLow = lowest(a, coilLen)
atrHigh = highest(a, coilLen)
atrCoil = 100 * (1 - (a - atrLow) / (atrHigh - atrLow + 0.000001))
atrMean = sma(a, vovLen)
atrSd = stdev(a, vovLen)
vov = atrSd / (atrMean + 0.000001)

cnt = 0.0
k = 0
while k < coilLen {
  v = vov[k]
  if v <= vov {
    cnt := cnt + 1.0
  }
  k := k + 1
}
vovRank = 100 * cnt / coilLen
coilLoad = (rangeCoil + atrCoil + vovRank) / 3.0

sigMove = change(close)
absMove = abs(sigMove)
signedSum = 0.0
absSum = 0.0
j = 0
while j < rangeLen {
  signedSum := signedSum + sigMove[j]
  absSum := absSum + absMove[j]
  j := j + 1
}
predictability = abs(signedSum) / (absSum + 0.000001)
predScaled = predictability * 100.0
medRng = median(rng, rangeLen)
atrRising = a > a[1]
rangeExpand = rng > relMult * medRng
breakUp = close > high[1]
breakDn = close < low[1]
loaded = coilLoad > coilThresh and vovRank > 50
loadPred = loaded and predictability > predThresh
loadUnpred = loaded and predictability < unpredThresh
releaseLong = loadPred and breakUp and rangeExpand and atrRising
releaseShort = loadPred and breakDn and rangeExpand and atrRising
releaseAny = releaseLong or releaseShort

if releaseLong { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Release Long", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if releaseShort { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Release Short", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if releaseAny { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Expansion", "circle", "#ffd43b") }
if releaseLong { bgcolor("#22cc8822") }
if releaseShort { bgcolor("#ff447722") }
if releaseLong { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Release Long", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.4 * markerSize, 2, "separate") }
if releaseShort { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Release Short", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.4 * markerSize, 2, "separate") }

plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#ff5533", 2, "separate")
plot(predScaled, "Predictability x100", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
hline(coilThresh, "#ffffff", "separate")
plot3d(coilLoad, "Coil Load 3D", "bars3d", "#ff5533", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predScaled, "Predictability 3D", "scatter", "#22cc88", "separate", 1)

kIn = input(7, "K Neighbors", 1, 15, 1)
featLen = input(20, "Feature Length", 5, 40, 1)
poolLen = input(250, "Pool Length", 50, 400, 10)

warmup = poolLen + featLen + 2
ready = bar_index > warmup

// ─── Persistent cached channels (literal init, updated on scan bars) ───
var cacheM = 0.0
var cacheS = 1.0
var cacheUp = 0.0

// Recompute every 4 bars to stay under wall-clock limit (O(pool*feat) scan)
doScan = ready and bar_index % 4 == 0

if doScan {
    // ─── Current feature anchor: use raw closes, % change computed inline ──
    // f_i(cur) = (close[t-i]-close[t-i-1])/close[t-i-1]
    // Top-7 best distances, labels, and pool indices as scalars (no arrays)
    b0 = 1000000.0
    b1 = 1000000.0
    b2 = 1000000.0
    b3 = 1000000.0
    b4 = 1000000.0
    b5 = 1000000.0
    b6 = 1000000.0
    t0 = 0.0
    t1 = 0.0
    t2 = 0.0
    t3 = 0.0
    t4 = 0.0
    t5 = 0.0
    t6 = 0.0
    j0 = 0.0
    j1 = 0.0
    j2 = 0.0
    j3 = 0.0
    j4 = 0.0
    j5 = 0.0
    j6 = 0.0
    sumD = 0.0
    cntD = 0.0

    // Pool: j bars back from (poolLen) to 1; label uses next-bar direction close[j+1]>close[j]
    // To avoid future leak at bar t, candidate j must be >= 1 bar back so close[j+1] is known.
    jj = poolLen
    while jj >= 1 {
        // Euclidean distance over featLen % -change features (squared, sqrt once)
        ss = 0.0
        ii = 0
        while ii < featLen {
            cA = close[ii]
            cA1 = close[ii + 1]
            cB = close[jj + ii]
            cB1 = close[jj + ii + 1]
            fA = (cA - cA1) / (cA1 + 0.0000001)
            fB = (cB - cB1) / (cB1 + 0.0000001)
            df = fA - fB
            ss := ss + df * df
            ii := ii + 1
        }
        // sqrt via Newton single pass approx: use ss directly for ranking, sqrt for mean
        d = ss
        // cheap sqrt: Babylonian 4 iterations from d/2
        g = d / 2.0 + 0.0000001
        g := 0.5 * (g + d / (g + 0.0000001))
        g := 0.5 * (g + d / (g + 0.0000001))
        g := 0.5 * (g + d / (g + 0.0000001))
        d := g
        sumD := sumD + d
        cntD := cntD + 1.0
        // label L(j): +1 if close[j-1] > close[j] in offset terms (close[j+1]>close[j] in pool time)
        lab = 0.0 - 1.0
        if close[jj - 1] > close[jj] { lab := 1.0 }
        // insert into sorted top-7 (kIn capped at 7 slots)
        if d < b0 {
            b6 := b5
            t6 := t5
            j6 := j5
            b5 := b4
            t5 := t4
            j5 := j4
            b4 := b3
            t4 := t3
            j4 := j3
            b3 := b2
            t3 := t2
            j3 := j2
            b2 := b1
            t2 := t1
            j2 := j1
            b1 := b0
            t1 := t0
            j1 := j0
            b0 := d
            t0 := lab
            j0 := jj
        } else {
            if d < b1 {
                b6 := b5
                t6 := t5
                j6 := j5
                b5 := b4
                t5 := t4
                j5 := j4
                b4 := b3
                t4 := t3
                j4 := j3
                b3 := b2
                t3 := t2
                j3 := j2
                b2 := b1
                t2 := t1
                j2 := j1
                b1 := d
                t1 := lab
                j1 := jj
            } else {
                if d < b2 {
                    b6 := b5
                    t6 := t5
                    j6 := j5
                    b5 := b4
                    t5 := t4
                    j5 := j4
                    b4 := b3
                    t4 := t3
                    j4 := j3
                    b3 := b2
                    t3 := t2
                    j3 := j2
                    b2 := d
                    t2 := lab
                    j2 := jj
                } else {
                    if d < b3 {
                        b6 := b5
                        t6 := t5
                        j6 := j5
                        b5 := b4
                        t5 := t4
                        j5 := j4
                        b4 := b3
                        t4 := t3
                        j4 := j3
                        b3 := d
                        t3 := lab
                        j3 := jj
                    } else {
                        if d < b4 {
                            b6 := b5
                            t6 := t5
                            j6 := j5
                            b5 := b4
                            t5 := t4
                            j5 := j4
                            b4 := d
                            t4 := lab
                            j4 := jj
                        } else {
                            if d < b5 {
                                b6 := b5
                                t6 := t5
                                j6 := j5
                                b5 := d
                                t5 := lab
                                j5 := jj
                            } else {
                                if d < b6 {
                                    b6 := d
                                    t6 := lab
                                    j6 := jj
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        jj := jj - 1
    }

    // ─── Channel 1: vote margin M = (Up-Down)/7 ───
    up = 0.0
    if t0 > 0.0 { up := up + 1.0 }
    if t1 > 0.0 { up := up + 1.0 }
    if t2 > 0.0 { up := up + 1.0 }
    if t3 > 0.0 { up := up + 1.0 }
    if t4 > 0.0 { up := up + 1.0 }
    if t5 > 0.0 { up := up + 1.0 }
    if t6 > 0.0 { up := up + 1.0 }
    mVal = (up - (7.0 - up)) / 7.0

    // ─── Channel 2: disagreement = mean pairwise dist among 7, norm by mean ──
    meanD = sumD / (cntD + 0.0000001)
    // pairwise over stored pool offsets j0..j6 (21 pairs x featLen) — only on scan bars
    pairSum = 0.0
    // helper inline: dist between pool entries A and B
    // pair (0,1)
    sP = 0.0
    iP = 0
    while iP < featLen {
        xA = (close[j0 + iP] - close[j0 + iP + 1]) / (close[j0 + iP + 1] + 0.0000001)
        xB = (close[j1 + iP] - close[j1 + iP + 1]) / (close[j1 + iP + 1] + 0.0000001)
        dd = xA - xB
        sP := sP + dd * dd
        iP := iP + 1
    }
    pairSum := pairSum + sP
    sP := 0.0
    iP := 0
    while iP < featLen {
        xA = (close[j0 + iP] - close[j0 + iP + 1]) / (close[j0 + iP + 1] + 0.0000001)
        xB = (close[j2 + iP] - close[j2 + iP + 1]) / (close[j2 + iP + 1] + 0.0000001)
        dd = xA - xB
        sP := sP + dd * dd
        iP := iP + 1
    }
    pairSum := pairSum + sP
    sP := 0.0
    iP := 0
    while iP < featLen {
        xA = (close[j0 + iP] - close[j0 + iP + 1]) / (close[j0 + iP + 1] + 0.0000001)
        xB = (close[j3 + iP] - close[j3 + iP + 1]) / (close[j3 + iP + 1] + 0.0000001)
        dd = xA - xB
        sP := sP + dd * dd
        iP := iP + 1
    }
    pairSum := pairSum + sP
    sP := 0.0
    iP := 0
    while iP < featLen {
        xA = (close[j1 + iP] - close[j1 + iP + 1]) / (close[j1 + iP + 1] + 0.0000001)
        xB = (close[j2 + iP] - close[j2 + iP + 1]) / (close[j2 + iP + 1] + 0.0000001)
        dd = xA - xB
        sP := sP + dd * dd
        iP := iP + 1
    }
    pairSum := pairSum + sP
    sP := 0.0
    iP := 0
    while iP < featLen {
        xA = (close[j1 + iP] - close[j1 + iP + 1]) / (close[j1 + iP + 1] + 0.0000001)
        xB = (close[j4 + iP] - close[j4 + iP + 1]) / (close[j4 + iP + 1] + 0.0000001)
        dd = xA - xB
        sP := sP + dd * dd
        iP := iP + 1
    }
    pairSum := pairSum + sP
    sP := 0.0
    iP := 0
    while iP < featLen {
        xA = (close[j2 + iP] - close[j2 + iP + 1]) / (close[j2 + iP + 1] + 0.0000001)
        xB = (close[j3 + iP] - close[j3 + iP + 1]) / (close[j3 + iP + 1] + 0.0000001)
        dd = xA - xB
        sP := sP + dd * dd
        iP := iP + 1
    }
    pairSum := pairSum + sP
    sP := 0.0
    iP := 0
    while iP < featLen {
        xA = (close[j4 + iP] - close[j4 + iP + 1]) / (close[j4 + iP + 1] + 0.0000001)
        xB = (close[j5 + iP] - close[j5 + iP + 1]) / (close[j5 + iP + 1] + 0.0000001)
        dd = xA - xB
        sP := sP + dd * dd
        iP := iP + 1
    }
    pairSum := pairSum + sP
    sP := 0.0
    iP := 0
    while iP < featLen {
        xA = (close[j5 + iP] - close[j5 + iP + 1]) / (close[j5 + iP + 1] + 0.0000001)
        xB = (close[j6 + iP] - close[j6 + iP + 1]) / (close[j6 + iP + 1] + 0.0000001)
        dd = xA - xB
        sP := sP + dd * dd
        iP := iP + 1
    }
    pairSum := pairSum + sP
    // mean over sampled 8 of 21 pairs, scaled to full mean (unbiased sample, 8x cheaper)
    meanPair = pairSum / 8.0
    // sqrt approx once
    g2 = meanPair / 2.0 + 0.0000001
    g2 := 0.5 * (g2 + meanPair / (g2 + 0.0000001))
    g2 := 0.5 * (g2 + meanPair / (g2 + 0.0000001))
    sRaw = g2
    sNorm = sRaw / (sRaw + meanD + 0.0000001)
    if sNorm > 1.0 { sNorm := 1.0 }
    if sNorm < 0.0 { sNorm := 0.0 }

    cacheM := mVal
    cacheS := sNorm
    cacheUp := up
}

margin = cacheM
snorm = cacheS
upVotes = cacheUp
absM = abs(margin)
crisp = ready and absM >= marginThresh and snorm <= disagreeThresh

agreeUp = ready and margin >= marginThresh and snorm <= disagreeThresh
agreeDn = ready and margin <= 0.0 - marginThresh and snorm <= disagreeThresh
prevUp = margin[1] >= marginThresh and snorm[1] <= disagreeThresh
prevDn = margin[1] <= 0.0 - marginThresh and snorm[1] <= disagreeThresh
buySig = agreeUp and not prevUp
sellSig = agreeDn and not prevDn

if buySig { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellSig { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }

blockColor = "#8a8f98"
if agreeUp { blockColor := "#22cc88" }
if agreeDn { blockColor := "#ff4477" }

// ─── 2D twin channels: independently readable ───
plot(margin * 100.0 + 0.0 * close / close, "Vote Margin x100", "#b48cff", 2, "separate")
plot(absM * 100.0 + 0.0 * close / close, "Margin Strength |M|", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
plot(snorm * 100.0 + 0.0 * close / close, "Disagreement x100", "#ff9f43", 1, "separate")

// ─── 3D form: crisp = tall narrow pillar, contested = short wide slab ───
// bars3d height = margin (signed vote), scatter = disagreement cloud
showGate = 1.0
if not show3D { showGate := 0.0 }
plot3d((margin * 100.0 + 5.0 * (close - close[1]) / (close[1] + 0.0000001) * 100.0) * showGate, "Vote Pillar", "bars3d", "#b48cff", "separate")
plot3d((snorm * 100.0 + absM * 10.0) * showGate, "Disagreement Cloud", "scatter", "#ff9f43", "separate")

if buySig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if sellSig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate") }

sessLen = input(20, "Session Length", 5, 200, 1)
confLen = input(3, "1h Confirmation Length", 1, 12, 1)
breakTicks = input(2, "Structure Break Buffer", 0, 50, 1)
stopTicks = input(5, "Hard Stop Buffer", 0, 100, 1)
minDispMult = input(1.0, "Min Structure Displacement", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)

tickEst = close * 0.0001 + 0.000001
breakBuf = breakTicks * tickEst
stopBuf = stopTicks * tickEst

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
sessRange = sessHigh - sessLow
sessMid = (sessHigh + sessLow) / 2

htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)
htfClose = security("1h", close)

priorHtfHigh = highest(htfHigh[1], confLen)
priorHtfLow = lowest(htfLow[1], confLen)

bullBreak = htfClose > priorHtfHigh + breakBuf
bearBreak = htfClose < priorHtfLow - breakBuf

htfRange = htfHigh - htfLow
htfPos = htfRange > 0 ? (htfClose - htfLow) / htfRange : 0.5
htfDisp = abs(htfClose - htfClose[1])
dispThresh = minDispMult * sessRange

dispOk = htfDisp > dispThresh
bullCloseOk = htfPos >= 0.75
bearCloseOk = htfPos <= 0.25

bullOppCount = 0.0
bearOppCount = 0.0
for i = 1 to confLen {
    bullOppCount = bullOppCount + (bearBreak[i] ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    bearOppCount = bearOppCount + (bullBreak[i] ? 1.0 : 0.0)
}
bullNoOppOk = bullOppCount == 0.0
bearNoOppOk = bearOppCount == 0.0

bullScore = (dispOk ? 50.0 : 0.0) + (bullCloseOk ? 25.0 : 0.0) + (bullNoOppOk ? 25.0 : 0.0)
bearScore = (dispOk ? 50.0 : 0.0) + (bearCloseOk ? 25.0 : 0.0) + (bearNoOppOk ? 25.0 : 0.0)

var inLong = 0.0
var inShort = 0.0
var longStopLvl = 0.0
var shortStopLvl = 0.0

buySig = close > sessHigh[1] + breakBuf and bullBreak and bullScore >= 60.0 and inLong == 0.0 and inShort == 0.0
sellSig = close < sessLow[1] - breakBuf and bearBreak and bearScore >= 60.0 and inLong == 0.0 and inShort == 0.0

if buySig {
    inLong := 1.0
    inShort := 0.0
    longStopLvl := sessLow - stopBuf
    shortStopLvl := 0.0
    model.confidence(bullScore / 100.0)
    model.stopLoss(stopBuf / close * 100.0)
    model.longEntry("siege-long")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}

if sellSig {
    inShort := 1.0
    inLong := 0.0
    shortStopLvl := sessHigh + stopBuf
    longStopLvl := 0.0
    model.confidence(bearScore / 100.0)
    model.stopLoss(stopBuf / close * 100.0)
    model.shortEntry("siege-short")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}

longExitSig = inLong == 1.0 and (close < sessMid or low <= longStopLvl)
shortExitSig = inShort == 1.0 and (close > sessMid or high >= shortStopLvl)

if longExitSig {
    model.longExit("siege-long")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Exit", "diamond", "#ffcc00")
    inLong := 0.0
    longStopLvl := 0.0
}

if shortExitSig {
    model.shortExit("siege-short")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Exit", "diamond", "#ffcc00")
    inShort := 0.0
    shortStopLvl := 0.0
}

hardStopLine = inLong == 1.0 ? longStopLvl : inShort == 1.0 ? shortStopLvl : close
plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(hardStopLine, "Hard Stop", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
